question:
As per the figure given below, ΔQRS ≅ ________. [Note: Diagram is not drawn to scale or measurements indicated.] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b804d538537cded5100e5862f2dec0472553210bba91f48384894bd535c3cd15.png]
solution:
**Given:**

PQ = QR

PT = RS

QT = QS

∠P = ∠R

∠T = ∠S

**Concept Used:**

Similarity Rule

**Calculation:**

Since, 

PQ = QR

PT = RS

QT = QS

∠P = ∠R

∠T = ∠S

⇒ ΔQRS ≅ ΔQPT (Side Angle Side Similarity Rule)

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
